underground.limestone-drip-cave.name: Limestone Drip Cave
underground.limestone-drip-cave.description: Solution cave with rounded limestone walls and selective speleothems.

underground.basalt-lava-tube.name: Basalt Lava Tube
underground.basalt-lava-tube.description: Volcanic tunnel left by drained lava, with dark smooth-to-ropy rock forms and occasional collapse openings.

underground.talus-boulder-cave.name: Talus Boulder Cave
underground.talus-boulder-cave.description: Irregular voids between large fallen angular boulders with tight squeezes and broken sightlines.

underground.sea-cave.name: Wave-Cut Sea Cave
underground.sea-cave.description: Coastal cave eroded along fractures by waves, with a wet rock floor and visible ocean connection.

underground.underground-river-cavern.name: Underground River Cavern
underground.underground-river-cavern.description: Large natural chamber shaped around a flowing subterranean river.

underground.crystal-cavern.name: Crystal Cavern
underground.crystal-cavern.description: Natural chamber punctuated by a limited number of large crystalline growths.

underground.fungal-cavern.name: Fungal Cavern
underground.fungal-cavern.description: Damp cave chamber dominated by a few large mushroom and shelf-fungus forms.

underground.mine-tunnel.name: Abandoned Mine Tunnel
underground.mine-tunnel.description: Excavated rock passage supported by rough timber and practical mining remains.

underground.dressed-stone-corridor.name: Dressed-Stone Corridor
underground.dressed-stone-corridor.description: Purpose-built dungeon passage of fitted blocks and flagstones.

underground.trapped-stone-corridor.name: Trapped Stone Corridor
underground.trapped-stone-corridor.description: Built passage whose architecture visibly supports hazards and trap mechanisms.

underground.barracks-passage.name: Underground Barracks Passage
underground.barracks-passage.description: Fortified corridor widened for guards, drills, and stored military equipment.

underground.catacomb-niches.name: Catacomb Niche Hall
underground.catacomb-niches.description: Burial passage lined with large wall niches, stone coffins, or bone repositories.

underground.cistern.name: Dungeon Cistern
underground.cistern.description: Stone water-storage chamber with channels, grates, and damp masonry.

underground.rotunda.name: Dungeon Rotunda
underground.rotunda.description: Circular built chamber organized around a central pillar, well, statue, or floor motif.

underground.crypt.name: Stone Crypt
underground.crypt.description: Burial chamber with substantial tomb architecture and restrained funerary decoration.

underground.armory.name: Abandoned Armory
underground.armory.description: Dungeon storage area for weapons and armor with practical racks and ruined metal.

underground.refuse-pit.name: Refuse Pit
underground.refuse-pit.description: Sunken waste area beneath a dungeon with large discarded objects and organic debris kept visually simple.

underground.webbed-chapel.name: Webbed Underground Chapel
underground.webbed-chapel.description: Small subterranean sacred space partly abandoned and overtaken by webs.
